cues.underripe: bright green cast, very firm, starchy smell
cues.ripe: full cultivar color, firm, light floral scent at stem
cues.peak: rich color, gives barely under pressure, fragrant
cues.overripe: soft spots, wrinkled skin, mealy feel

cues.underripe: hard neck, still green (or bright yellow-green for Bartlett)
cues.ripe: neck gives slightly to gentle pressure; skin color deepened
cues.peak: neck yields easily; sweet aroma; a little soft at the stem

cues.underripe: mostly green peel, firm, no give
cues.ripe: yellow with green tips, slight give
cues.peak: fully yellow with small brown sugar spots, sweet aroma
cues.overripe: mostly brown peel, very soft, intense sweetness
cues.spoiling: black peel, mushy, fermented smell, leaking

cues.underripe: greenish patches, very firm, low aroma
cues.ripe: full orange color, heavy for size, firm with slight give
cues.peak: deep color, fragrant at stem, yields to squeeze
cues.spoiling: mold (blue or white fuzz), soft brown spots, leaking

cues.underripe: green patches, hard, very little aroma
cues.ripe: bright yellow, firm, light citrus scent
cues.peak: deep yellow, slight give, fragrant
cues.overripe: soft, dull yellow, shriveled near stem

cues.underripe: dark green, very hard, no aroma
cues.ripe: medium green, slight give, glossy skin
cues.peak: yellow-green cast, soft enough to squeeze juice easily

cues.underripe: green-tinged skin, very firm, low aroma
cues.ripe: yellow or pink blush, heavy for size, slight give
cues.peak: deep color, fragrant, yields gently

cues.underripe: greenish, very firm
cues.ripe: bright orange, slight give, easy to peel
cues.peak: deep orange, fragrant, skin slightly loose
cues.overripe: soft, very loose skin, juice pooling

cues.underripe: white shoulders near stem, pale red body
cues.ripe: uniformly deep red all the way to stem, glossy
cues.peak: deep red, fragrant, firm but juicy
cues.spoiling: white fuzzy mold, mushy, fermented smell

defects: white or gray mold (very common in clamshells)

cues.underripe: red or pink tint, firm
cues.ripe: deep blue-purple with silvery bloom, firm
cues.peak: uniform deep blue, plump, slight give
cues.spoiling: mold in the clamshell, leaking juice

defects: juice at the bottom of the clamshell

cues.underripe: light pink, hard, hollow feel
cues.ripe: deep red (or golden for yellow var), plump, slightly soft
cues.peak: deep red, fragrant, falls off the stem
cues.spoiling: white/gray mold, collapsed fruit, leaking juice

cues.underripe: red or purple (not fully black), hard, sour
cues.ripe: fully black, plump, firm with slight give
cues.peak: deep black, glossy, slight give

cues.underripe: white or pink, very hard
cues.ripe: deep red, firm, bouncy when dropped
cues.peak: deep red, very firm

cues.underripe: hard, pale yellow or green undertone
cues.ripe: gives slightly under pressure, fragrant at stem
cues.peak: gives easily, very fragrant, deep red blush with yellow/cream

cues.underripe: very firm, dull color, no give
cues.ripe: deep color with silvery bloom, slight give at stem
cues.peak: soft all over, fragrant, juicy when pressed

cues.underripe: hard, pale, no aroma
cues.ripe: slight give, fragrant, smooth deep color
cues.peak: gives easily, very fragrant

cues.underripe: firm, pale or green-tinged
cues.ripe: deep orange, slight give, sweet aroma
cues.peak: soft with a faint blush, fragrant

cues.underripe: pale red, firm, stem green and fresh
cues.ripe: deep red or mahogany, firm plump flesh, green stem
cues.peak: very dark red, glossy, fragrant, stem still green
cues.spoiling: mold at stem, leaking, fermented smell

cues.underripe: tart, firmly attached to stem, pale
cues.ripe: full cultivar color, firm, still attached to green stems
cues.peak: deep color, fragrant, firm attachment
cues.overripe: wrinkled, falling off the stem, brown stems

cues.underripe: white-green field spot, shiny skin, green tendril
cues.ripe: creamy-yellow field spot, dull skin, hollow thump sound
cues.peak: deep yellow/orange field spot, dried tendril at stem, heavy for size
cues.overripe: very dull, soft spots, sloshing sound
cues.spoiling: soft mushy patches, oozing, off smell

cues.underripe: green under the netting, no aroma, hard
cues.ripe: tan-cream under the netting, slight give at stem end, fragrant
cues.peak: strong sweet aroma, gives under thumb pressure at stem

cues.underripe: pale green, shiny hard skin
cues.ripe: creamy-yellow skin, slightly waxy feel, slight give at stem
cues.peak: pale yellow, fragrant, soft at stem

cues.underripe: green skin, stiff leaves, very firm
cues.ripe: yellow-gold at the base, inner leaves pull out with moderate tug, fragrant
cues.peak: deeply golden, strong sweet aroma, slight give
cues.overripe: very soft, dull brown patches, fermented smell

cues.underripe: firm, green skin, no aroma
cues.ripe: gives to gentle pressure, fragrant at stem, skin turning red/yellow (variety-dependent)
cues.peak: very fragrant, soft all over, full color

cues.underripe: green skin, very hard
cues.ripe: orange-yellow skin, gives to pressure
cues.peak: mostly yellow/orange, soft, fragrant

cues.underripe: very firm, no give
cues.ripe: gives slightly to thumb pressure
cues.peak: soft but not mushy, fragrant

cues.underripe: pale red, perfectly round, hard
cues.ripe: deep red, angular/squarish shape, heavy for size
cues.peak: deeply colored, heavy, slight brown patina acceptable

cues.underripe: firm, upright stem, no aroma
cues.ripe: drooping stem, soft, small drop of nectar at the bottom eye
cues.peak: very soft, fragrant, split skin acceptable

cues.underripe: bright green, rock hard
cues.ripe: dark green-purple (Hass), yields to gentle pressure in the palm
cues.peak: very dark, soft at the stem, stem pops off to reveal green underneath
cues.overripe: very soft, stem reveals brown underneath

cues.underripe: hard, pale orange (Hachiya: astringent when hard)
cues.ripe: deep orange, slight give (Fuyu eaten firm; Hachiya eaten jelly-soft)
cues.peak: Fuyu: firm but ripe. Hachiya: translucent skin, jelly-like
